people.imagined: Dawn on the rocks of the sun-bathing island. He sits barefoot on wet black stone mending a net, a small brown old man with nothing about him to notice, until he lifts his head and turns his eyes on the viewer.
people.subject: The moment: seated barefoot on wet black rock at dawn with a fishing net across his knees, he has just lifted his head and looks straight at the viewer. Face: a small, narrow, deeply brown face seamed like dried fruit; thin white brows; a short nose; a toothless-looking soft mouth in a mild half-smile; a wisp of white beard; and the eyes, the most important thing: large, clear and unnaturally bright, the irises banded in five colours, thin rings of pale gold, green, deep blue, red and brown, drawn big and plain. Hair: thin white hair tied in a knot with a strip of sea-grass. Body: small, wiry, bent, barefoot with horny feet. Clothing: a fisherman's coat of coarse indigo-dyed hemp, clean and well cut, with neat reinforcing squares of darker cloth stitched at the elbows, open at the neck over a plain undershirt; rolled linen trousers; a string of sea-polished pebbles at the neck. Hands and objects: gnarled brown hands hold a half-mended net and a bone needle; at his side on the rock stands a plain unglazed clay vase the height of a forearm, beaded with cold dew; on a cord at the wrist hangs one small clear stone bead with a grain of sand held motionless in its centre. Background: a pale sea, a low sun, a dark rock edge, a faint ring of light beyond the horizon. Light: soft pink dawn light from the upper left, the vase cold blue-grey. Expression: a mild, patient half-smile on the soft mouth, ancient and unhurried, with the banded eyes seeing a good deal more than the face lets on. A hint of all five colours very faintly in the air.

people.imagined: Late afternoon at his corner table in the market. One cup stands untouched in front of him; he is watching the crowd with a long sad calm and has not yet drunk. The sword on his back shows a grey crane on its guard.
people.subject: The moment: seated at a corner table in a busy market with a full cup before him, watching the crowd, a long sword across his back. Face: a long, narrow, stooped face with a high forehead; weathered brown skin; deep lines running from nose to mouth; thin iron-grey brows; calm grey eyes, steady and a little sad; a long straight nose; a thin mouth closed; a short grey beard, neat. Hair: grey, long, tied back low with a cord, a few strands at the temple. Body: tall, thin, stooped, long-limbed, sitting very still. Clothing: a long travelling coat of old grey cloth, clean and finely made, cut from panels in many different shades of grey so that the garment reads as a quiet patchwork of greys; a faded cord belt; a plain linen shirt. Hands and objects: both hands lie flat on the table on either side of a small untouched cup of pale wine; behind his right shoulder rises the hilt of a long narrow sword, and on its guard a small cut crane in grey metal, big enough to read; at the hilt a carved pale bone pendant in the shape of a bird's wing. Background: a blurred market, awnings, hanging lanterns, a stall of pots. Light: warm late-afternoon light from the upper left with a cool grey shadow. Expression: a quiet, long-patient look, the calm grey eyes a little sad and the thin mouth closed, the face of a man waiting for a wind that will come at dusk. A faint cold silver gleam along the blade.

people.imagined: At the stone lip of a pool at dusk. He sits with his head tilted as if someone is speaking very quietly, his burn-white eyes open on nothing, the lightning scar glinting down his neck. He is listening to a bell under the water.
people.subject: The moment: seated on a stone pool edge at dusk, his head tilted to one side as if listening to a whisper, his eyes white and open. Face: a broad, still, calm face; eyes completely burn-white, the irises gone, the whites pale and scarred, big and plain; heavy straight dark brows; a broad nose; a calm closed mouth; and, from the crown of his head down over the left temple, cheek, jaw and neck, a branching lightning scar, pale pink-white like a fern, running down to the collarbone, the second mark and clearly visible. Hair: dark and thin, short, burnt away along the scar line. Body: broad, heavy-shouldered, seated square and still. Clothing: a robe of dark indigo cloth burnt through at both shoulders, fine and clean, left unmended, the burn-edged holes showing his bare shoulders; a plain rope belt. Hands and objects: both hands rest on his knees; beside him on the stone lies a small bronze hand mirror cast with waves on one half and mulberry rows on the other. Background: a still dark pool reflecting the last dusk sky, a hanging bell half under water, soft mist. Light: low blue dusk light from the upper left, the scar catching a pale highlight. Expression: calm, patient, listening. A faint blue-violet tint of storm about him.

people.imagined: Remembered: the ice swordsman at the edge of a glacier at the hour he set out to find the oldest man alive, sword in hand, white breath, stubborn with trust.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait of an ice swordsman at forty-five, standing on a frozen slope holding a pale blade point-down before him, his breath white. Face: a lean, sharp, wind-cut face; skin pale with a frost-burn pink on cheeks and nose; heavy straight dark brows; steady pale blue eyes; a straight nose; a firm mouth; short dark stubble with frost on it. Hair: black, to the shoulder, tied back with a strip of white fur, frost glittering along it. Body: tall, lean and upright, broad in the shoulder, standing firm in the snow with his weight set down through the blade. Clothing: a long coat of grey-white wolf fur, trimmed and clean, over a dark fitted tunic; a belt of braided white cord; fur-lined gauntlets. Hands and objects: both hands rest on the pommel of a long slender sword whose blade looks like clear glacier ice, with a thin pale-blue shine, point down in the snow. Background: a vast blue-white glacier rolling away in long cracked folds, a pale sky, far dark mountains, and one line of his own boot prints in the snow behind him. Light: cold clear light from the upper left. Expression: a quiet, resolute, trusting look, the pale blue eyes steady and the firm mouth set, a man who has chosen to meet heaven with empty hands. The whole picture faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, edges darkened. A faint ice-blue tint.

people.imagined: Remembered: the alchemist at her three-legged furnace in violet smoke, lifting the lid to smell, certain of her last pill, with a dyer's stained fingers.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait of the great alchemist at forty, lifting the lid of a violet bronze furnace and sniffing the rising smoke. Face: a refined, intelligent, narrow face; skin pale with a faint warm flush; eyes half-closed in concentration, long lashes; thin arched brows; a fine straight nose lifted slightly; a small mouth with a satisfied curve; a faint purple stain on the chin. Hair: black, in a high elaborate knot with two jade pins and a red hairpin, a loose strand at the temple. Body: slim, graceful, bending slightly forward. Clothing: a long robe of deep crimson silk dyed in layers from rose to rust at the hem, fine and clean, wide sleeves tied back with cords; an apron of pale hemp. Hands and objects: the fingers of both hands are stained in dye colours, purple, red and yellow to the second joint; the right hand holds the lid of a three-legged bronze furnace gone violet with age, purple smoke curling up past her sleeve. Background: shelves of jars and bundled herbs rising behind her to the beams, a paper window with a bright square of sky, a low table of mortars and scales, and a faint curl of smoke along the ceiling. Light: warm light from the upper left, lit from below by purple smoke glow. Expression: an absorbed, certain, hungry look, the eyes half-closed in a long inhale and the small mouth curving with satisfaction. The whole picture faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, edges darkened. A faint violet tint.

people.imagined: Remembered: the fire cultivator at a volcanic vent mouth, fanning a red fan at the heat, impatient, eager to go deeper.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait of a fire cultivator at thirty-five, standing at a glowing vent in black rock, fanning himself with a red fan, grinning with eagerness. Face: a young, sharp, sunburnt face; bright orange-brown eyes; thick dark brows; a hooked nose; a wide eager grin; soot on one cheek. Hair: dark red-brown, spiky, tied with a cord, singed at the tips. Body: lean, strong, a miner's shoulders. Clothing: a short coat of rust-red cloth open at the chest, with leather bracers and a heat-scorched belt; clean otherwise; bare calves in boots. His stance is wide and eager, one foot on a ledge of black rock and the knee bent, leaning toward the glow; sweat has darkened the neckline of his coat and made the hair stick to his brow. The rust-red coat is trimmed with dull-gold braid and fastened with horn toggles; leather bracers cover his forearms and soot lies on the backs of his hands. Hands and objects: the right hand holds a fan with red iron ribs and a fire-silk face painted with flame shapes, no writing, lifted; the left points down into the vent. Background: Around him a steep slope of glassy black rock, a long crack in the earth glowing bright orange with white heat at its centre, curls of pale steam, a broken ledge with a rope tied to a spike, and, above, a low smoky sky reddened from below. Light: strong orange vent light from the lower right. Expression: an impatient, brave, fierce look, the eyes narrowed against the heat and the jaw set, a young man in a hurry to burn brightly. The whole picture faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, edges darkened. A faint ember glow.

people.imagined: Remembered: the swordswoman on a river road at dusk, a jade flute at her lips, playing the falling-plum tune before a duel, plum blossoms drifting.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait of a swordswoman at thirty-eight, playing a pale jade flute with her eyes closed on a river bank under falling plum petals. Face: an open, handsome, sun-browned face; closed eyes; strong dark brows; a straight nose; a relaxed mouth at the flute; a small scar through the left eyebrow. Hair: black, in a loose high tail tied with a green ribbon, a plum blossom behind the ear. Body: tall, lean, easy, broad-shouldered. She stands with her weight on her back foot as if about to step into a dance, the shoulders loose, the elbows lifted as the flute rises; her chest is high with breath. Clothing: a plain boatwoman's jacket of deep blue cloth in a fine cut, with a short travelling skirt over trousers; a scarlet sash; boots. The deep blue jacket is fitted with a standing collar, short skirts over trousers tucked into soft boots; a short curved knife is slung in a plain scabbard at the back and a plum branch lies at her feet. Hands and objects: both hands hold a slender pale-green jade flute to her lips; the flute's end shows a thin blade line. Background: Behind her the river is wide and silver, a sampan with a single lantern, small white petals falling in the air and scattered on the water, a low city of tiled roofs far off in dusk haze, and a rising pink-gold sky. Light: golden dusk light from the upper left. Expression: a relaxed, generous, careless calm, the eyes closed and the lips on the flute, a faint smile on a woman at ease with the world. The whole picture faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, edges darkened. A faint white-pink petal tint.

people.imagined: Remembered: the water master walking out over a vast still lake toward a huge pale moon, not looking back, his reflection under every step.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait of a water master of forty-five walking away over a still moonlit lake, seen three-quarters from behind with his face turned a little back, his steps leaving ripple rings. Face: a calm, plain, lean face turned in profile; closed-looking calm eyes; level brows; a straight nose; a gentle mouth; a short grey-black beard. Hair: long black hair loose down the back, hanging completely still despite the faint wind. Body: tall, slender and straight, walking unhurriedly with his arms loose and his head turned slightly back so the profile is clear; his steps leave ripple rings that spread in perfect circles across the black water, one behind each footfall. Clothing: a long robe of pale water-grey silk, simple and perfectly clean, wide sleeves, no ornament or border, the hem resting on the water without wetting; a plain belt. Hands and objects: both hands hang open at his sides. Background: an endless flat black lake under a huge pale full moon low over the water, its reflection a straight path of silver from his feet to its centre; behind him on the dim far shore a tiny shrine with a single lamp and a small dark figure kneeling; the sky deep blue-black and clear of cloud. Light: cold silver moonlight from the upper left. Expression: a serene, content look in profile, the calm eyes half closed and the gentle mouth almost smiling. The whole picture faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, edges darkened. A faint pale blue-silver tint.

people.imagined: Remembered: the last disciple on a small boat in a grey western sea, holding a bronze mirror up to the water, looking for sails that are gone.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait of a seafarer-scholar at forty-five standing in a small boat, holding a bronze hand mirror up before the sea, looking intently into it. Face: a lean, stubborn, weather-darkened face; deep-set grey eyes narrowed in a search; thick straight brows; a long nose; a firm mouth; a short grey-streaked beard. Hair: black with grey, tied up in a topknot, a scrap of cloth round the brow. Body: tall, lean and wiry, standing braced in the rocking boat with his knees soft and his shoulders square. Clothing: a long coat of dark sea-blue cloth, salt-whitened at the hem but clean and well cut; a leather satchel on the shoulder; sea boots. Hands and objects: the right hand holds up a bronze mirror whose back is cast with waves on one half and mulberry rows on the other, its face turned toward him; the left hand grips the mast, the knuckles white. Background: a grey sea under a grey sky, a small boat with its brown sail furled, and a ghostly faint line of sails far off in the mist. Light: pale grey light from the upper left. Expression: a patient, haunted, determined stare into the mirror, the deep-set grey eyes narrowed and the firm mouth held shut, looking for something he is afraid to find. The whole picture faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, edges darkened. A faint sea-blue tint.

people.imagined: On the little jetty at dusk, the boat tied up behind him, he is writing in a book on his knee with ink-stained fingers, glancing up at the old man's rock, deciding what the old man would have said.
people.subject: The moment: sitting on a jetty with a book in oilcloth open on his knee, brush in hand, glancing up at something out of frame. Face: a lean, sun-black face; sharp cheekbones; thoughtful dark eyes; strong straight brows; a long nose; a mouth held tight over a decision; a thin line of grey in a short beard. Hair: black, tied back in a knot with a rope-end. Body: lean, wiry, a rower's shoulders, sitting hunched. Clothing: a boatman's coat of tough dark blue cloth, fine and clean, the sleeves tied at the wrist; rolled trousers; bare feet; a rope belt with a ledger wrapped in oilcloth hung from it. Hands and objects: the right hand holds a brush, every fingertip stained deep black with ink; the left holds the open book, its pages ruled with columns of small drawings, no writing; a ledger wrapped in oilcloth hangs at his belt. Background: a small boat bobbing at the jetty's foot, a darkening sea, and far away on a rock a seated tiny figure, a pilgrim waiting. Light: low orange dusk light from the upper left, the page glowing warm. Expression: a careful, conflicted, calculating look, the eyes lifted from the page and the mouth held tight over a decision he has not yet made. A faint cool sea tint.

people.imagined: On the herb mountain, bending over a cassia bed in the evening light, her basket on her back, tasting a leaf; she is in the middle of deciding something about someone far away.
people.subject: The moment: bending over a bed of dark-leaved cassia with a leaf between her fingers, about to taste it, a big basket on her back. Face: a small, narrow, grey, wrinkled face; very bright black eyes; thin grey brows; a sharp small nose; a thin mouth parting to taste; a faint patient smile of a woman making a record. Hair: grey, pulled into a tight small bun under a brown headcloth that sits low over her brow. Body: small, thin and bent, quick; she leans from the waist with her free hand on her knee, the whole small frame tipped forward, the basket's strap biting into her shoulder. Clothing: a plain brown robe of fine hemp, clean and well made, dyed cinnamon at the hem, with a leather apron and the sleeves rolled; a wide basket strap across the chest; at her belt a small bronze scale in a case and a bundle of pill-papers tied with thread, unmarked. Hands and objects: both hands are stained deep cassia-brown to the wrist, large in the picture; the right pinches a leaf; the basket on her back overflows with green and red herbs. Background: Around her stand terraces of herb beds rising up the mountain in even rows, dark glossy cassia bushes in the foreground, a small steaming pond with a bamboo pipe, a distant slate roof with a plume of smoke, and a boy with a basket, small and blurred, in the next row. Light: warm gold evening light from the upper left. Expression: a shrewd, watchful, patient half-smile, the bright black eyes fixed on the leaf as if she were making a record of it. A faint warm brown-green tint.

people.imagined: At night on a bare peak, the wind changing, she stops mid-sentence with her head turned, the flute at her belt, one hand on its end like a sword hilt.
people.subject: The moment: standing on a bare mountain peak at night, head snapping toward a change in the wind, one hand on the end of the bamboo flute at her belt. Face: a long, lean, bony face with high cheekbones; skin brown and wind-scoured; sharp watchful grey eyes; thin straight brows; a long straight nose; a mouth pressed shut mid-word. Hair: black, in a long single braid blown sideways by the wind, the end tied with a bit of grey cord. Body: tall, long-boned and narrow-hipped, balanced on the balls of her feet at the very edge of the peak, her cloak and braid streaming. Clothing: a long mine-grey robe of good wool-linen, clean and fitted, belted at the waist; leather gloves; a scarf of dark wool at the throat whipping sideways. Hands and objects: the right hand grasps the end of a bamboo flute thrust through her belt like a sword, as if to draw it; the left hand lifts, fingers spread, to test the wind. Background: a black rock edge falling away into a huge starry sky, the peak's bare crown, and low at the left a faint grey door set in the rock, half in shadow. Light: cold starlight and a pale low moon from the upper left, a thin silver rim along her cheek and braid. Expression: an alert, guarded, lonely look, the grey eyes snapped toward the wind and the mouth pressed shut mid-word. A faint pale-grey wind-swept tint.

people.imagined: On the prow of a fishing boat in a squall, describing the sea out loud to nobody, one arm stretched out with the fern-shaped lightning scars lit by a far flash.
people.subject: The moment: standing on a boat prow in wind and spray, one arm thrust out toward the sea, mouth open as she describes it aloud. Face: a wiry, sharp, windburnt face; lips cracked and white with salt; bright, hard, greedy dark eyes; thin brows; a short nose; a wide mouth open mid-word. Hair: short black salt-stiff hair. Body: wiry, tough and lean, knees bent and feet planted in the pitch of the deck, the right arm shot out ahead and the whole body leaning into the wind, the throat bared and corded. Clothing: a short sea-blue jacket of fine oiled cloth, clean, with the right sleeve cut off at the shoulder so the scarred arm is bare; wide linen trousers; a band of sailcloth round the waist and a rope belt with a small brass bell. Hands and objects: the right arm, bare, is covered from shoulder to wrist in a pink-white fern-pattern of lightning scars, big and plain; the left hand grips a stay rope, the fingers cracked and salt-white. Background: Around the boat a black sea heaves in high grey-green swells, white spray streaming off the bow, a low line of cloud split by a distant fork of lightning in violet-white, a small sail straining, and on the stern a second figure, a grey-haired boatman, crouched at the tiller. Light: dim stormy light from the upper left, a purple lightning flash. Expression: a fierce, boastful, exhilarated look, the salt-cracked lips drawn wide mid-word and the hard dark eyes gleaming, a girl in love with the storm. A faint violet-white spark in the air.

people.imagined: At the tavern door on the first dawn of spring, laughing across the market square, a cup poured and held out, resin on her sleeves.
people.subject: The moment: standing at a tavern door at dawn holding out a small wine cup in both hands with a big laugh. Face: a round, rosy, quick face; sparkling brown eyes; arched brows; a small nose; a wide laughing mouth; dimples; a smudge of pale resin on the cheek. Hair: brown, in a thick knot with a pine twig tucked in. Body: round, quick, curvy, shoulders shaking. Clothing: a fine green-brown jacket, clean, sleeves rolled to show forearms, the cuffs sticky and gold-streaked with pine resin, plainly; a white apron; a bright red sash. She leans out of the doorway a little with her whole weight forward, shoulders shaking with the laugh, steam rising from the cup; her round arms are bare to the elbow and a ring of pine resin shines gold on each cuff. The green-brown jacket is clean and well cut, the apron white with a small red embroidered flower, and a pine twig hangs from her bun. Hands and objects: both hands hold out a small white cup of pale wine, steam rising; behind her a row of dark jars. Background: Behind her the tavern's low wooden interior holds rows of dark jars on shelves and a lantern; across the square the farewell pavilion stands with red lanterns lit in the pale dawn and the shapes of early market sellers setting out baskets; a tall grey figure sits at a corner table, blurred. Light: pink dawn light from the upper left. Expression: a warm, merry, sly laugh, the eyes crinkled and the wide mouth open, a host already plotting the next joke over the cup. A faint pine-green tint.

people.imagined: Midday in the herb yard. He is sleepy over a grinding stone, wiping his flattened nose on the back of his wrist, then on his sleeve, with an easy lazy smile.
people.subject: The moment: sleepy over a grinding stone at midday, wiping his nose on the back of his wrist. Face: a round, soft, good-natured face; a flattened, crooked nose with an old break that never set straight, drawn big; heavy-lidded eyes half closed; thick brows; a slack friendly mouth. Hair: brown, tousled, a herb sprig in it. Body: stocky, soft and slouched, his elbow on the table and his chin almost on his hand, the belly pressing against the table's edge, one eye nearly closed; the flattened nose is shiny where he has rubbed it. Clothing: a plain brown robe of good hemp, clean and loose, with a pale apron stained green at the front; at his belt a bundle of small pill-papers tied with thread and a gourd. Hands and objects: the right wrist swipes at the nose; the left hand rests on a stone pestle in a stone mortar of green paste. Background: The herb yard around him is bright and sunny, with racks of drying leaves, a clay stove with a small pot, baskets of grey-green roots, a pale path down the mountain, a boy carrying a basket in the blur, and a few bees circling the mortar. Light: bright midday light from the upper left. Expression: a slack, sleepy, good-natured look, the heavy lids half down and the loose mouth ready to give away whatever he has. A faint green.

people.imagined: On a frost road, keeping his left hand in his sleeve while he unrolls a map with the other, an eager hard look in his eye at a far white peak.
people.subject: The moment: standing on a snowy road, one hand in his sleeve, the other unrolling a map, eyes on a far peak. Face: a lean, hungry, sharp face; keen pale blue eyes; thin brows; a sharp nose; a thin tight mouth; a short thin stubble; chapped skin. Hair: black, tied in a knot, rimed with frost. Body: lean and hunched against the cold, the left arm held tight across his chest and the hidden hand half-withdrawn into the sleeve. Clothing: a fur-lined grey coat of fine cloth, clean, with a high wolf-fur collar and leather cuffs, the left sleeve held across the body; a scarf wound twice round his throat. Hands and objects: the right hand holds a large map with small drawn mountains and a red dot, no writing, its edge flapping in the wind; the left hand, half out of its sleeve, shows three fingers whose tips are gone, the remaining nails white and ridged, clearly drawn. Background: a snow road running up a long white slope toward a pale blue peak with a hazy crown of cloud, footprints leading away behind him, a dark line of pines at the left, a few dry grasses poking through the snow. Light: cold white light from the upper left, hard on his reddened, chapped cheeks. Expression: an eager, hungry, ambitious look, the keen pale eyes fixed on the peak and the thin mouth tight with wanting it. A faint ice-blue tint.

people.imagined: Sitting beside a hot spring in the cold, singed brows pulled down, she looks over a pilgrim's face and decides before they speak.
people.subject: The moment: seated cross-legged beside a steaming vent, singed eyebrows low, looking hard at someone out of frame. Face: a lean, hard, flushed face; eyebrows singed to short black stubble, big and plain; dark narrow eyes; a hooked nose; a thin mouth that has already decided; red-pink cheeks from the heat. Hair: black, tied up under a cloth, a few singed ends. Body: wiry and upright, sitting straight with her ankles crossed and her hands gripping her knees, the head angled forward so the gaze comes up hard from under the singed brows; her cheeks red with the heat while her hands stay pale. Clothing: a rust-red robe of fine quilted cloth, clean, quilted in tight diamonds with a stiff high collar; a black belt carrying a small iron pot on a hook; fingerless gloves of grey wool. Hands and objects: both hands rest on her knees beside a small black pot with a lid; steam rises from the vent. Background: black volcanic rock steaming and glowing at its cracks, vents hissing white clouds, a few scattered pilgrims' stones in a circle, sleet slanting across the frame in thin grey lines, and a small bundle left by a previous visitor lying untouched at the edge. Light: orange light from the vent below. Expression: a cold, level, decisive glare, the thin mouth set and the dark eyes unmoved, a woman who has already made up her mind about the one in front of her. A faint ember glow.

people.imagined: Asleep standing, then awake, on a ledge with the empty sky, a gap-toothed whistle on his every word, seabird droppings dried on his shoulders like epaulettes.
people.subject: The moment: sitting on a rock ledge looking up at an empty sky, lips pursed round a whistle through a missing front tooth. Face: a long, lazy, tanned face; half-closed hopeful eyes; thick brows; a missing upper front tooth visible in a small round whistling mouth; stubble. Hair: sun-bleached brown, a feather in it. Body: lanky and slouched, sitting with his knees drawn up and his spine slumped against the rock, the head tilted back so the long throat shows, the sky reflected in the pale eyes; a gull feather tucked behind his ear. Clothing: a long brown coat of fine cloth gone soft and pale at the cuffs with years of wear, the sleeves a little short, a rope belt looped twice round his waist; on both shoulders crusts of dried white seabird droppings arranged like epaulettes, plainly visible. Hands and objects: the right hand holds a long wooden whistle-pipe; the left lifts to shade the eyes. Background: The ledge is a cracked slab of grey rock above a drop to the sea; seabirds stand in rows on the ledges below, nests in the crevices, thin white streaks on the rock, and a vast pale sky with one very high thin cloud and nothing else. Light: bright light from the upper left. Expression: a dreamy, idle, hopeful look, the half-closed eyes on the empty sky and the lips pursed round the whistle, a man who can wait. A faint sky-blue tint.

people.imagined: At the oars of the pilgrims' boat, deciding by whim, looking a would-be passenger up and down with a wet cropped head and no intention of rowing them yet.
people.subject: The moment: sitting at the oars of a small boat, arms folded across them, scrutinising someone out of frame, her cropped hair dripping. Face: a freckled, bright, impish face; wet short black hair plastered flat; sharp brown eyes; arched brows; a snub nose; a mouth pursed to refuse. Hair: cropped very short, soaking wet. Body: wiry, strong shoulders. Clothing: a short blue jacket of oiled cloth, clean; wide trousers rolled; bare feet; a cord belt. She sits with her back straight and feet braced on the thwart, her chin lifted and her bare shoulders broad; wet cropped hair drips on her collar and a bead of water runs down her nose. The short blue oiled jacket is open over a faded linen shirt, the trousers are rolled to the knee, the cord belt carries a small bone whistle; a red ribbon is tied round her left wrist. Hands and objects: both hands lie over two oars; each palm bears a wide round callus, as big as a coin, shown plainly. Background: The boat sits on grey-green water with a small slapping wave at its side, a rope trailing to a wooden post, a dark island rock with a tiny seated figure on top, a mist hanging low over the water, and on the jetty a boy in a wide hat waiting. Light: soft grey light from the upper left. Expression: a saucy, appraising squint with one brow cocked and the lips pushed to a smirk, a boatwoman sizing up her passenger and finding a price for him. A faint sea-blue tint.

people.imagined: At the door of the market, tired from the road, coughing into her sleeve, plum petals still in her hem, deciding to ask the old swordsman anyway.
people.subject: The moment: standing in a market lane, coughing into her sleeve, then looking up with a stubborn set face toward a figure at a table out of frame. Face: a thin, pale, determined face; flushed cheeks; large dark honest eyes; strong straight brows; a small nose; a firm young mouth. Hair: black, in two braids tied with white cloth. Body: thin, small, held upright against the cough. Clothing: a plain white-grey quilted coat of good cloth, clean; a hem that carries a trail of pressed pink-white plum petals, plainly visible; a small wooden practice sword tucked through her belt. Her thin shoulders shake as she coughs into the left sleeve, then straighten; her right hand is balled and her jaw jutted forward. The white-grey quilted coat has a high collar and big wooden toggles, with the hem dragging a trail of pink-white plum petals pressed flat by the road; the practice sword at her belt is a plain stick of pale wood, its grip wound with red cord. Hands and objects: the left sleeve at her mouth; the right fist clenched. Background: The market lane is narrow and busy, with awnings, hanging lanterns, a stall of grey pots and a seller of hot buns steaming in the cold, a tall stooped man in a grey coat seated at a far corner table in the blur, and thin winter sunlight lying on the wet paving. Light: grey light from the upper left. Expression: a tired, stubborn, determined face, the mouth set hard after the cough and the eyes lifted straight at the figure, refusing to look as weak as she feels. A faint pale pink petal tint.

people.imagined: In the cassia bed with a basket, three bees on his shoulder and one on his hat, picking carefully, grinning at the sun.
people.subject: The moment: picking leaves from a cassia bed with a basket on his arm, bees circling his head and resting on his shoulders. Face: a round, trusting, freckled face; bright eyes; a snub nose; a wide grin. Hair: brown, curly, a bee on it. Body: slight, quick. Clothing: a cinnamon-brown hemp robe, clean, the sleeves stained cinnamon-brown; a basket strap. The cinnamon-brown hemp robe has sleeves stained a deeper brown to the elbow, with a woven belt and a bamboo hat hanging at his back; his feet are bare and dusty. Hands and objects: the right hand picks a leaf; the left carries a basket of green leaves; five bees in the air. He stands with a slight lean to one side, the basket on the left arm and the right hand reaching up, a bee on the back of his wrist which he ignores; his light freckled face is turned up. Background: The cassia bushes stand in rows, dark and glossy with small yellow flowers, a low wall of grey stones, the thatched roof of a hut, a cloud of bees rising golden in the sun, and in the distance a small grey woman bent over a bed, watching him with folded hands. Light: warm light from the upper left. Expression: a broad, happy, unbothered smile with the eyes half closed in pleasure, bees crawling on his shoulders and not a flinch. A faint cinnamon-brown tint.

people.imagined: In a leaking hired boat, bent double by forty crossings, bailing with a cup, her white braid new for the spring, still looking ahead.
people.subject: The moment: sitting in a small wooden boat, bailing water with a wooden cup, her face lifted toward the far island. Face: a small, deeply lined brown face; faded eyes fixed ahead; thin white brows; a small nose; a patient, set mouth. Hair: a thick rope of white hair braided freshly and tied with a red thread. Body: small, bent double with age, thin-armed, sitting hunched with her knees together and her back bowed like a bent bow, the shoulders high; her eyes never leave the island. Clothing: a plain dark-blue quilted jacket of good cloth, clean, with matching reinforcing cloth at the elbows; a grey headscarf folded on her shoulders; a faded blanket over her knees; a rope belt. Hands and objects: the right hand bails with a wooden cup; the left grips the gunwale; her hands are small, brown and gnarled; the white braid with its red thread lies over her shoulder; around her feet an inch of water. Background: The boat is old and low, water pooled around her sandals and a visible dark crack along one plank; the grey sea runs flat to a low green island under a pale mist, gulls turning overhead, and a single full sun-bleached oar trailing in the water. Light: pale grey light from the upper left. Expression: a patient, set, stubborn look, the faded eyes fixed on the island and the mouth held in a firm line, a woman who has made this crossing for forty years and will make it again. A faint sea-blue tint.
